select TRIM(t.SECURITYID)|| '.IB' secid, t.SETTLCURRENCY ccy, DECODE(t.SIDE, '1', 'P', 'S') ps, t.PRICE price8, t.YIELD2 yield8, t.STRIKEYIELD strikeyield, t.DIRTYPRICE dirtyprice, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTAMT accruedinterestamt, t.SETTLTYPE settleSpeed, t.LASTQTY prinamt, t.SETTLCURRAMT settamt, t.OURTRADERNAME trad, t.COUNTERTRADERNAME clienttrader, t.COUNTERTELEPHONE countertelephone, t.OURDEPOSITACCOUNTNUMBER ourdepositaccountnumber, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTAMT unitInt, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTTOTALAMT convintamt, 'E' effectflag, to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') inputdate, TO_DATE(t.TRADEDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') dealdate, TO_DATE(t.SETTLDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') settdate, DECODE(t.EXECTYPE, '4', to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') revdate, 1 updatecounter, t.EXECID fedealno, t.TEXT dealtext, t.UPDATETIME lstmntdate, t.CLEARINGMETHOD clearingmethod, t.DELIVERYTYPE deliverytype, t.COUNTERINSTITUTIONCODE cno
from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.updatetime = (select max(t.updatetime) from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select DECODE(t.MARKETINDICATOR, 9, 'H01', 10, 'H03', '') prodtype, TRIM(t.SECURITYID) secid, DECODE(t.SIDE, '4', 'RS', 'RB') ps, 'N' crtrevdealstatus, 'IB' market, 0 ismanaul, 'O' clienttype, TO_DATE(t.TRADEDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') dealdate, TO_DATE(t.SETTLDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') vdate, TO_DATE(t.SETTLDATE2, 'YYYYMMDD') mdate, t.settldate2 - t.SETTLDATE term, t.SETTLCURRENCY ccy, t.PRICE reporate, 'A/365' basis, DECODE(t.MARKETINDICATOR, 9, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTTOTALAMT, 10, t.SETTLCURRAMT2 - t.SETTLCURRAMT) repointamt, DECODE(t.MARKETINDICATOR, 9, t.TRADECASHAMT, 10, t.SETTLCURRAMT) repoamt, t.SETTLCURRAMT vdealamt, t.SETTLCURRAMT2 mdealamt, DECODE(t.DELIVERYTYPE, 0, 'DVP', 4, 'PUD', 5, 'DUP') vclrform, DECODE(t.DELIVERYTYPE2, 0, 'DVP', 4, 'PUD', 5, 'DUP') mclrform, t.COUNTERTRADERNAME selltrader, t.TEXT dealtext, DECODE(t.EXECTYPE, '4', to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') revdate, t.UPDATETIME lstmntdate, 'E' effectflag, t.LASTQTY facetotalamt, t.COUNTERINSTITUTIONCODE seller, t.SECURITYID termType, t.CB_FPRICE_AMT, t.SC_FPRICE_AMT, t.OURDEPOSITACCOUNTNUMBER ourdepositaccountnumber, CASE WHEN t.SETTLDATE = t.TRADEDATE THEN '1' ELSE '2' END settleSpeed from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.updatetime = (select max(t.updatetime) from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select PORTFOLIO_ID from
IBU_QUOTE_BOND
IBU_QUOTE_CREP
where CFETS_QUOTE_ID = #{quoteid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select mcp.COUNTER_ID from MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp INNER JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci ON mcp.COUNTER_NAME = mcci.PARTY_NAME WHERE mcci.PARTY_ID = #{cpPartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN IBU_PORTFOLIO_ACCT_RELA T2 ON T2.PARTY_ID = T1.PARTY_ID WHERE T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL
AND T1.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID = #{ourinstitutioncode}
